_about: Te Araroa's usual resupply stops, southbound, as walkers' published resupply guides describe them (BikeHikeSafari, Let's Trek It, Freewheeling Kiwi, Treks Travels Thoughts, sjcamacho, Sean Maskill and others, checked November 2026), with the bounce-box points the Te Araroa Trust confirms (St Arnaud, Boyle, Arthur's Pass). Facts only, in our own words. tools/te-araroa.mjs places each stop on the trail (its km, and how far off the trail) from the gazetteer and adds the shops named in the Trust's section notes. level: full (a supermarket: a full resupply), limited (a small store: top-ups, or a careful resupply), box (no shop worth relying on: send a box). Shops and hours change: check before relying on any of it.

stops.name: Ahipara
stops.note: Small store at the end of Ninety Mile Beach.

stops.name: Kaitaia
stops.note: Pak'nSave and other supermarkets, a short hitch from Ahipara.

stops.name: Kerikeri
stops.note: Countdown and New World.

stops.name: Paihia
stops.note: Supermarket and shops.

stops.name: Whangārei
stops.note: City, by a side trip from the trail.

stops.name: Waipu
stops.note: Four Square.

stops.name: Mangawhai Heads
stops.note: Big New World; outdoor gas at the hardware store.

stops.name: Auckland
stops.note: Supermarkets along the way through the city's suburbs; outdoor stores.

stops.name: Huntly
stops.note: Shops for snacks and lunch; most walkers do the full shop in Hamilton.

stops.name: Hamilton
stops.note: Full resupply; outdoor stores.

stops.name: Te Kūiti
stops.note: New World.

stops.name: Taumarunui
stops.note: New World.

stops.name: National Park
stops.note: Small store; plan the Whanganui River food here or before.

stops.name: Whanganui
stops.note: City: full resupply after the river.

stops.name: Bulls
stops.note: Small-town shops on the trail.

stops.name: Feilding
stops.note: Supermarkets on the trail before Palmerston North.

stops.name: Palmerston North
stops.note: City: several supermarkets; last big shop before the Tararua Range.

stops.name: Levin
stops.note: Supermarkets, a hitch off the trail.

stops.name: Waikanae
stops.note: Full resupply after the Tararua Range.

stops.name: Wellington
stops.note: City: full resupply and outdoor stores; many walkers send South Island boxes from here.

stops.name: Picton
stops.note: Supermarkets at the ferry terminal town.

stops.name: Havelock
stops.note: Four Square; walkers often send a box here for the Richmond Range.

stops.name: Pelorus Bridge
stops.note: Café with snacks and meals only.

stops.name: St Arnaud
stops.note: Small alpine store, basic food; send a box (the Trust lists the Alpine Lodge).

stops.name: Boyle Village
stops.note: No shop: send a box to the Boyle Outdoor Education Centre, or hitch to Hanmer Springs.

stops.name: Hanmer Springs
stops.note: Four Square and more, a hitch from Boyle Village or the Lewis Pass road.

stops.name: Arthur's Pass
stops.note: Small store and café, very basic food; send a box.

stops.name: Methven
stops.note: SuperValue and Four Square, a hitch from the Rakaia River; boxes can be held in town.

stops.name: Geraldine
stops.note: FreshChoice, a hitch from the Rangitata River.

stops.name: Lake Tekapo
stops.note: Four Square; the post office can forward boxes.

stops.name: Twizel
stops.note: Four Square.

stops.name: Lake Hāwea
stops.note: Small store and café; better to carry through to Wānaka.

stops.name: Albert Town
stops.note: Full resupply on the way into Wānaka.

stops.name: Wānaka
stops.note: New World; outdoor stores.

stops.name: Arrowtown
stops.note: Convenience store for a basic resupply.

stops.name: Frankton
stops.note: Pak'nSave by the trail near Queenstown.

stops.name: Queenstown
stops.note: FreshChoice, Four Square and outdoor stores.

stops.name: Te Anau
stops.note: FreshChoice, a hitch of about 28 km from the trail; boxes can be held in town.

stops.name: Tuatapere
stops.note: Small-town shops before Longwood Forest.

stops.name: Riverton
stops.note: SuperValue right by the trail.

stops.name: Invercargill
stops.note: City: Pak'nSave, Countdown and New World.

stops.name: Bluff
stops.note: The end of the trail.
